evidence: Modifies configuration and startup error handling in `src/node/caches.cpp` when parsing settings from `settings.json`.
rationale: Fixes a startup crash caused by `std::terminate` when `settings.json` contains an invalid `dbcache`. Removing `noexcept` from `LogOversizedDbCache` allows the parse error to reach `AppInit`'s top-level exception handler and produce a clear error message instead of an abort.
